meaning: Low supply voltage: Bosch says the house power supply to the dishwasher is too low.
causes: Incoming voltage from the house supply is too low for the dishwasher, the cause Bosch gives
diySteps: Switch the dishwasher off at the circuit breaker for 30 seconds, then switch it back on
If E27 appears again, Bosch says to have an electrician check the incoming voltage to the appliance
safetyNote: Do not open the dishwasher's junction box or measure live voltage yourself; checking the supply at the appliance is electrician work. Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: Bosch's step after a repeat E27 is a licensed electrician, not an appliance repair: the fault Bosch names is the house supply, not the dishwasher.
sourceTitle: Bosch Dishwasher Error Codes: Troubleshooting Guide (Bosch)
